rules: status starts at 'pending' and may ONLY become 'passing' after the verify steps were actually executed and observed to pass.
Code compiling, typechecking, or looking correct is NOT sufficient to mark 'passing'.
If a verify step cannot be run, set status 'blocked' and fill 'blocked_by'. Never guess.
'deferred' means out of scope by explicit user decision. Do not implement deferred features.
Run `node scripts/features.mjs` to see the current tally. Never hand-edit the tally.
Update this file in the same change that implements the feature, not at session end.

blockers.anthropic_key_unset: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not exported in the shell (nor set on the Vercel project), so no live Claude call can run; narration serves templates and unknown vendors stay 'default'.

verify: `npx vercel dev -L --listen 3100` at the repo root starts both services; GET localhost:3100/api/health returns {ok:true,pandas:<version>} and GET localhost:3100/ renders the probe page showing both API responses.

features.description: Deterministic Lumen Labs dataset in Rho's transaction schema: 12 months of history plus inject-1 and inject-2, with every DESIGN.md §5 scenario planted, and a vendor taxonomy with descriptor aliases.
verify: `cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_data.py` passes: regenerating into a temp dir is byte-identical to the committed JSON; planted numbers hold (Anthropic Sep = 1.55–1.65× Aug, Pinecone one Aug charge ≈ $2,500 and one Sep ≈ $6,500, Loom last charge 2026-07-06, Figma $990 → $1,210, Vanta 2025-10-12 $18,000, Notion seats 40 → 58); schema sanity (Rho enum types, negative debits, integer minor units, unique ids, posted_at null iff pending).
Breaking a planted constant (ANTHROPIC_SEP_MULTIPLIER 1.60 → 1.30) makes the suite exit 1 both before and after regeneration; restoring it returns to green with identical file hashes.
features.evidence: 2026-09-12: agent run 38 passed; deliberate-break runs exited 1 (byte-identity test, then the Anthropic ratio test); restored → 38 passed, SHA-256 unchanged. Integrator re-ran `uv run pytest tests/test_data.py -q` on the branch: 38 passed in 0.74 s. Rows: history 2,484 / inject-1 51 / inject-2 181. Aug 2026 spend $485,951 (payroll $325,444).

features.description: Deterministic pipeline (filter → resolve → series → baseline → gate 1 unusual → gate 2 material → route → explain) behind POST /api/run, per DESIGN.md §6.
verify: `cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_pipeline.py` passes: trajectory-vs-level, price change, new vendor (ask when unclassified), stopped, per-head, spike, dedupe against open issues, escalation, refunds netting, excluded money movement, unknown enum tolerance, override precedence.

Mutations bite: level instead of trend, dedupe removed, stopped sign flipped, refunds not negated, ask forced false, partial-month gate removed, sigma floor removed, materiality forced true, new-vendor window check removed — each makes its guarding test fail.
`uv run python scripts/eval_scenarios.py` on the real data exits 0: the planted scenarios route as labelled per stage and nothing unplanned is emitted.
features.evidence: 2026-09-12: agent 33 passed + 9 mutations (M7 sigma floor and M9 new-vendor window were not caught on the first pass; tests tightened). Integrator: full suite 106 passed after the merge reconciliation (Classification confidence Literal, title-cased unknown vendors, report floor, 30-day renewal lookahead, stopped visible 2 cycles). eval_scenarios.py: see PROGRESS.md for the run.

features.description: Batched Claude classification of unknown vendors (cached per process, {} on failure so the pipeline keeps 'default' and still asks) and grounded narration with a deterministic template fallback behind POST /api/narrate (X-Narration: claude | mixed | template).
verify: `cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_llm.py` passes with a fake client: one call for five vendors, per-vendor fallback on bad entries, {} on API error or missing key, cache means reruns make no call, budget guard raises on the N+1th call, grounding check flags unsupported numbers, templates non-empty for every kind, report grouping and open-issue routing, route headers.
Mutating facts.py (exact comparison instead of rounding tolerance; grounding always true; K/M multiplier dropped) fails 5 / 6 / 8 tests respectively.
features.evidence: 2026-09-12: agent 34 passed + 3 mutations bite. Integrator: suite green at 106 after reconciliation; `/api/narrate` returned X-Narration: template for all three stages with no key (templates render in the UI, see integration-e2e).
